summary.text: Brian Hardin is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 48 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hardin was born in Scottsbluff, Nebraska, and graduated from Gering High School in 1984.
He earned a B.A. from Chadron State College in 1988 and a master of divinity from Denver Seminary in 1992.
His career experience includes working as a business consultant, farmer and rancher, pastor and insurance broker.
Hardin assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as chair of Health and Human Services and member of Banking, Commerce and Insurance and Nebraska Retirement Systems.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
